goal.outcome: The face and the loop sit in proportion to the copy instead of dominating the screen, and the man page is still readable when it opens.
goal.path: Land, read the name and the tagline, look at the face, click a contact tile. Scroll to the about copy with a small Mobius beside it, click to decode when curious.
goal.why: On shot-1440 the Mobius is back in the hero at 318 wide against a 473 column, a panel beside the name rather than a wall opposite it, and the face is back in the About column at 254 where it reads as a portrait next to the copy instead of half the hero. The manual auto-scales to its frame, so a fixed small frame would have rendered the man page at 6.6px: the frame returns to its readable size only while the manual is open (473x612 desktop at 13.8px body, 340x512 mobile at 12.4px body) and drops back to the small clip on close, and the hero is items-start so that growth never moves the name.

states.default: 1440x900. Hero: text left, Mobius terminal right at 318x414 at rest, expanding to 473x612 while the manual is open, with the name pinned (0px shift). About: prose left, portrait 254x254 above the facts in the right column. No horizontal overflow, zero console errors on the production build at :3101.
states.mobile: 390x844. Single column, scrollWidth 390, no overflow. Seven contact tiles hold one row at 44px each with a 5px gap, measured from the DOM: 7 tiles, 1 row. Mobius clip 286x380 under them at y=458, panel 340x512 while open with the man page at 12.4px. Portrait 238x238 further down in About at y=1697.
states.reduced-motion: The two new size transitions carry motion-reduce:transition-none, compiled in the build CSS as @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.motion-reduce\:transition-none{transition-property:none}}, so the frame snaps between the two sizes instead of animating. The boxes land at the same measurements because the sizing is state-driven, not animation-driven.
states.manual-open: Verified at both widths by clicking the decode button and reading the FitToBox scale: 0.923 desktop, 0.994 mobile. Both above the 0.80 point where the man page starts to look shrunk.
